title: Riyas Makeover
subtitle: Ladies Parlour, Bridal Makeup Studio & Spa
description: A 450 sq.ft. beauty destination in Kaliaganj that brings a ladies parlour, a bridal makeup studio and a private spa room under one brand, with arched styling mirrors, a regal makeup studio and a calm, textured spa, each zone given its own character.
body:
Riyas Makeover brings three services under one roof in Kaliaganj: a ladies parlour, a bridal makeup studio and a private spa room. Within 450 sq.ft., each zone was given its own character, while a shared material palette of terrazzo, light wood and soft white keeps the brand experience consistent from reception to treatment.

The parlour is bright and practical. Arched styling mirrors with backlit product niches line one wall, a teal slatted ceiling marks the shampoo station, and a sculpted partition with pill-shaped cut-outs separates the waiting lounge from the styling floor. The reception counter and recessed shelving double as a retail display for hair and skin care products.

The makeup studio takes a more theatrical turn for bridal and party clients, with a hand-painted Indian heritage mural, Hollywood bulb mirrors, velvet seating, red drapes and a brass chandelier. The spa room, by contrast, is calm and enclosed, with textured walls, warm wood joinery and soft lighting for facials and treatments.
features.0.title: Arched Styling Stations
features.0.text: Three full-height arched mirrors trimmed in white sit against a hand-drawn pattern wallpaper, separated by backlit product niches and light-wood drawer units. A teal fluted skirting band ties the stations together and protects the wall at chair height.
features.1.title: Shampoo Station & Feature Ceiling
features.1.text: The wash area is defined by a stepped teal slatted ceiling with linear LED lights and track spotlights. A recliner shampoo unit sits beside a warm-lit wooden shelving bay, against a line-art figure wallpaper that gives the corner its own identity.
features.2.title: Reception & Retail Display
features.2.text: A white terrazzo-top reception counter on a light-wood base, with a glowing toe-kick, faces a backlit arched niche carrying the Riyas Makeover logo. Recessed shelves with concealed lighting double as a retail display for hair and skin care products.
features.3.title: Waiting Lounge & Cut-Out Partition
features.3.text: A sculpted white partition with pill-shaped cut-outs screens the styling area from the waiting lounge while still allowing glimpses through. A low white sofa, planter and retail shelving complete a bright, welcoming arrival zone.
features.4.title: The Bridal Makeup Studio
features.4.text: The makeup studio takes on a regal mood. Hollywood-style bulb mirrors sit above a white vanity with green velvet chairs, while a hand-painted Indian heritage mural with a peacock, deep red drapes under a wooden pelmet and a brass chandelier set the stage for bridal and party makeovers.
features.5.title: A Statement Waiting Corner
features.5.text: An oversized blue velvet wingback chair, a carved dark-wood mirror, a vintage console with a rotary telephone and a Persian rug give the studio a theatrical corner for clients and companions, and a backdrop for photographs.
features.6.title: A Calm Private Spa Room
features.6.text: The spa room is deliberately quiet, with textured walls, terrazzo flooring and light-wood joinery. A treatment bed faces a terrazzo-top vanity with a vessel basin, a ring pendant light and a softly lit shelf, while illustrated skincare prints add warmth.
highlights.0.title: Three Zones, One Brand
highlights.0.text: A parlour, a bridal makeup studio and a spa room, each with its own mood, within 450 sq.ft.
highlights.1.title: Arched Mirror Stations
highlights.1.text: Full-height arched mirrors with backlit product niches between each station.
highlights.2.title: Heritage Makeup Studio
highlights.2.text: Peacock mural, velvet seating, red drapes and Hollywood bulb mirrors for bridal work.
highlights.3.title: Sculpted Cut-Out Partition
highlights.3.text: Pill-shaped openings divide the waiting and styling zones without closing them off.
highlights.4.title: Integrated Retail Display
highlights.4.text: Backlit shelving at reception and the stations turns product storage into sales display.
highlights.5.title: Hard-Wearing Terrazzo
highlights.5.text: Terrazzo flooring and counter tops chosen to handle chemicals, water and daily footfall.
